entry.author: Ministry for Pacific Peoples
entry.summary:
Step into the world of Tongan traditions through the eyes of our little ones. The tau'olunga, a dance deeply rooted in Tongan culture, comes alive today in a truly special way. 😍
Meet the talented children from Akoteu Kato Kakala Early Childhood Education Centre, who are performing their tau'olunga to celebrate Tonga Language Week.

For Tonga Language resources visit: mpp.govt.nz/Tonga23
#TongaLanguageWeek
